title: libcuflynx module array (<prefix>_module_array.json)
description: A list of module instance records. Each record has name, module_type, module_subtype, and optional inp_instances and out_instances. Other keys are allowed. A record may name its parameterisation ("parameterisation"). A supermodule instance may add per_submodule_inputs / per_submodule_outputs. See libcuflynx/utilities/config_schemas.py.

name.description: A name with no whitespace inside it (surrounding whitespace is stripped): names become CellML component and variable names.

nameList.description: instance names: a list, or one space-separated string (null: none). A name may be a path to a submodule of a supermodule instance, "heart/ra" ("neuron/soma/membrane" two levels down)

perSubmodule.description: {submodule: [host, ...]}, or a list of one-key objects. A submodule may appear once (the loader checks this; JSON Schema cannot). A key may be a path into a nested supermodule instance ("soma/membrane").

name.description: Required. The instance name, unique in the array; a module's parameters and variables are named <variable>_<name>.

module_type.description: Required. The module type: the module_type of a module config entry.

module_subtype.description: Required. The module version: the module_subtype of that entry.

inp_instances.description: The instances feeding this one (connected to its entrance ports). Default: none.

out_instances.description: The instances this one feeds (connected to its exit ports). Default: none.

per_submodule_inputs.description: Supermodule instances only: {submodule: [host instance, ...]}, the host instances feeding each submodule. Each host must list this instance in its out list. Default: none.

per_submodule_outputs.description: Supermodule instances only: {submodule: [host instance, ...]}, the host instances each submodule feeds. Each host must list this instance in its inp list. Default: none.

parameterisation.description: the parameterisation (named parameter set of the module version) whose parameters this record uses: <config dir>/parameterisations/<name>/<name>_parameters.csv (default: the config entry's default_parameterisation, if that file exists)

allOf.description: "instance" is not a record key: a record names its parameter set with "parameterisation".

^phlynx_.description: PhLynx's own metadata (layout, interface labels); read and ignored

instanceName.description: an instance name (surrounding whitespace is dropped): no whitespace inside, no "/", no "__", and no "_" at either end (nested levels are joined with "__": heart/lv is heart__lv)
